name: KERNEL OMEGA v1.5
description: Title: KERNEL OMEGA v1.5 — OMEGA vs BASELINE: The Definitive Benchmark and the Extreme Epistemic Torture Test Between Two AIs (LSS Protocol) Description: This record contains the complete experimental documentation and final validation dataset for KERNEL OMEGA v1.5, featuring the Structural Epistemic Validation Protocol (SEVP) v1.0. The dataset documents a rigorous comparative evaluation trajectory (OMEGA vs. Baseline) and the execution of the extreme epistemic torture test framework (LSS Protocol / Failure Set v1.0). Starting from an unstable baseline performance of 55%, the protocol implements systematic recursive correctors to eliminate structural vulnerabilities—specifically targeting fawning, defensive underconfidence, dogmatic overconfidence, causal confounding, and prompt-dependency. Key Highlights of the Deposit: Master Experimental Record: Complete multi-phase progression matrices across Alpha and Beta environments, tracking performance from initial baseline up to the crystallized validation threshold of 94%. The LSS Protocol / Failure Set v1.0: Comprehensive documentation of 40 complex adversarial items simultaneously testing opposite pathological failure modes (formal logic, statistics, causality, falsification, and pressure resistance). Methodological Rigor & Calibrations: Explicit containment metrics, boundary-condition delimitations for causal inference, and strict non-dogmatic generalization statements.
